decisions.what: Kept variations_count beside the new blocks[].variations despite the spec's 'replaces' wording.
decisions.why: The spec's own version_policy (v1 clients keep working) outranks the section prose; removing a v1 field is a wire break.

decisions.what: bindable_attributes ships as a version-aware vendored map (paragraph/heading/image/button) behind the x_companion_bindable_attributes filter.
decisions.why: Core hardcodes the allowlist in a local variable inside WP_Block::process_block_bindings — not reflectable; the map mirrors canon verbatim and the filter adopts future core expansion without a release.

decisions.what: Block style source labels are best-effort: 'theme' when the style name appears in theme-origin theme.json variations for that block, 'agent' when tracked by the schema provides option, else 'plugin'.
decisions.why: register_block_style() does not record its caller; no API exposes registration provenance.

decisions.what: No new cache-invalidation hooks for model changes: the platform stamp is a fingerprint input and the manifest transient is keyed by fingerprint.
decisions.why: Registration happens on init before any REST read; the fingerprint IS the invalidator by construction, and hooks like registered_post_type fire on every request.
